name: One Night Ultimate Werewolf

categories.label: Player won
categories.hint: Judge by final card (after night), not starting card

categories.label: Werewolf died in the vote
categories.hint: Any werewolf among the dead means the Village wins

winCondition: Village wins if at least one Werewolf dies, or if no player holds a Werewolf and nobody dies. Werewolf team wins if a player holds a Werewolf and no Werewolf dies. All players tied for most votes die. Tanner wins only by dying (special rules per role card).

roles.label: Tanner
roles.winCondition: Tanner dies; then Village and Werewolves lose

endCondition.description: One night, one discussion, one simultaneous vote

notes: family: hidden-role-social. Official rulebook PDF unavailable; win/tie rules verified via UltraBoardGames. Tanner interaction and Vampire/other expansion teams not verified from a fetched source. Roles are determined by final card after the night.
